passages.text: Please read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our consolidated financial statements and related notes included under Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Forward-looking statements are statements that attempt to forecast or anticipate future developments in our business, financial condition, or results of operations. When reviewing the discussion below, you should keep in mind the substantial risks and uncertainties that could impact our business. In particular, we encourage you to review the risks and uncertainties described in "Part I, Item 1A. Risk Factors" included elsewhere in this report. These risks and uncertainties could cause actual results to differ materially from those projected in forward-looking statements contained in this report or implied by past results and trends. Forward-looking statements, like all statements in this report, speak only as of their date (unless another date is indicated), and we undertake no obligation to update or revise these statements in light of future developments. See the section titled "Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" in this report. This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Overview Unity offers a suite of tools to develop, deploy, and grow games and interactive experiences across all major platforms from mobile, PC, and console, to extended reality (XR). Our platform consists of two complementary sets of solutions: Create Solutions and Grow Solutions. Starting in the fourth quarter of 2023, we began to reset our product and service offerings to focus on our core businesses, which we refer to as our "Strategic Portfolio": primarily, the Unity Engine and related consumption services, and monetization solutions. Recent Developments in Our Business In the year ended December 31, 2025, we had reductions to our workforce and our office footprint, that resulted in approximately $33 million in employee separation costs, and $14 million of non-employee charges associated with these reductions. We will continue to evaluate our facility needs. For additional details, refer to the section titled "Risk Factors." passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations, and Industry We have a history of losses and may not achieve or sustain profitability on a GAAP basis in the future. We have experienced significant net losses on a GAAP basis in each period since inception. In addition, our revenue has varied and, in certain periods, declined and could vary or decline in the future. We are not certain whether we will achieve or maintain profitability in the future. Our costs and expenses may increase in the long term on a GAAP basis, which could negatively affect our future results of operations. In addition, our investments in areas such as: • research and development, including investments in our engineering teams and in further differentiating our platform, as well as the development of new solutions and features; • our sales and marketing organizations to engage our existing and prospective customers, increase brand awareness and drive adoption and expansion of our platform and solutions; • initiatives to grow our presence in new or adjacent industries and use cases beyond the gaming industry; • our technology infrastructure, including systems architecture, hosting, scalability, availability, performance, and security; • acquisitions or strategic investments; • global expansion or restructuring; and • our general and administration organization, including legal, IT, and accounting expenses, will vary from period to period, which will impact our costs and ability to achieve and maintain profitability. Even if such investments increase our revenue, any such increase may not be enough to offset any increase in operating expenses. Cost-cutting efforts, such as discontinuing certain product offerings, reducing our workforce or reducing our office footprint, may not be effective or may not be effective on the timelines or to the extent we expect. Our past results may not be indicative of future operating performance. You should not rely on our past results of operations as indicators of future performance. Overall growth of our revenue is difficult to predict and depends, in part, on our ability to execute on enhancing our artificial intelligence (“AI”) capabilities and data infrastructure, our ongoing business realignment, and other growth strategies. You should evaluate our prospects in light of the risks and uncertainties frequently encountered by growing companies in rapidly evolving markets. These risks and uncertainties include challenges in accurate financial planning as a result of limited historical data relevant to the current scale and scope of our business and the recent changes to our business and operating model. If we are not able to grow efficiently, and manage our costs, we may not achieve profitability on a GAAP basis. We aim to achieve and maintain profitability on a GAAP basis. To do so, we need to continuously improve our platform’s capabilities, features and functionality. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow has expanded steadily across the three-year trend, reaching a level that comfortably covers capital expenditure and leaves a substantial free cash flow surplus. This internally generated liquidity, rather than earnings, is the primary source of debt service for the convertible notes and supports the issuer's ability to meet obligations without external funding.

The balance sheet carries a large unrestricted cash position that exceeds the current portion of convertible debt, and the current ratio sits modestly above the sector median. This liquidity buffer, combined with a net debt figure that is small relative to the debt stack, provides meaningful headroom against refinancing or operating shocks.

key_risks.text: The issuer has incurred significant GAAP net losses in every period since inception, and management explicitly cautions that profitability may not be achieved or sustained. Operating income remains deeply negative, with an operating margin far below the sector median, so debt service depends on cash flow rather than earnings and is vulnerable to any revenue or cost deterioration.

The debt stack consists entirely of convertible notes, split between a current portion due within a year and a noncurrent balance. With no aggregate debt line tagged and no maturity schedule disclosed, the refinancing profile is opaque; the current tranche must be repaid or refinanced from cash or new issuance, and a partial instrument sum may understate total obligations.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is deeply negative because operating income is negative, so the issuer cannot service interest from earnings. However, cash flow coverage is strong: free cash flow to debt sits well above the sector median, and operating cash flow covers interest expense many times over, indicating that cash generation, not accounting earnings, underpins debt service.

Liquidity is adequate for near-term maturities: cash exceeds the current convertible portion, and the current ratio is above the sector median. Still, the absence of a disclosed maturity schedule and the reliance on convertible refinancing mean the capacity to roll debt depends on market access and the issuer's equity price, which is a forward-looking judgement rather than a certainty.

overall_credit_view.text: The credit profile is not meaningfully captured by leverage ratios because EBITDA is negative; the indicative framework therefore points to liquidity runway rather than leverage headroom. Cash flow coverage and a substantial cash balance are the key supports, while persistent GAAP losses and an opaque convertible maturity profile are the principal constraints on the credit view.

Analyst judgement: the issuer's improving operating cash flow trend and cash-rich balance sheet suggest capacity to manage the current convertible maturity, but sustained GAAP profitability remains unproven and the Altman Z double prime zone flags distress. The credit view is therefore stable-to-cautious, contingent on continued cash generation and successful refinancing of the current tranche.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流在三年趨勢中穩步擴大，達到能輕鬆覆蓋資本開支並留下可觀自由現金流盈餘的水平。此內部產生的流動性，而非盈利，是可換股債券還款的主要來源，並支持發行人無需外部融資即可履行義務的能力。
資產負債表持有大量不受限制現金，超過可換股債務的流動部分，而流動比率略高於行業中位數。此流動性緩衝，加上相對於債務結構而言淨債務數字較小，為再融資或營運衝擊提供了有意義的緩衝空間。

key_risks.text: 發行人自成立以來每個期間均錄得重大GAAP淨虧損，管理層明確警告可能無法實現或維持盈利。營運收入仍深度負值，營運利潤率遠低於行業中位數，因此還款依賴現金流而非盈利，並容易受到任何收入或成本惡化的影響。
債務結構完全由可換股債券組成，分為一年內到期的流動部分和非流動餘額。由於沒有標記總債務項目，亦未披露到期時間表，再融資狀況不透明；流動部分必須以現金或新發行償還或再融資，而部分工具總和可能低估總義務。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率深度負值，因為營運收入為負，發行人無法從盈利中支付利息。然而，現金流覆蓋強勁：自由現金流對債務遠高於行業中位數，營運現金流覆蓋利息支出多倍，表明支撐還款的是現金產生而非會計盈利。
流動性足以應付近期到期債務：現金超過流動可換股部分，流動比率高於行業中位數。儘管如此，缺乏披露的到期時間表和依賴可換股再融資意味著滾動債務的能力取決於市場准入和發行人股價，這是前瞻性判斷而非確定性。

overall_credit_view.text: 信用狀況無法由槓桿比率有意義地反映，因為EBITDA為負；因此指示性框架指向流動性跑道而非槓桿緩衝空間。現金流覆蓋和大量現金餘額是關鍵支撐，而持續的GAAP虧損和不透明的可換股到期狀況是信用觀點的主要制約。
分析師判斷：發行人改善的營運現金流趨勢和現金充裕的資產負債表表明有能力管理當前可換股到期債務，但持續的GAAP盈利能力仍未經證實，而Altman Z雙素區域標誌著困境。因此信用觀點為穩定至審慎，取決於持續的現金產生和當前部分成功再融資。
